from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689809/attempts/82cd395e7c604aefb1723d109802e08f/system/state/workspace/programs')
base.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    # Split the grid at full-zero separator rows and columns.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    row_seps = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == 0 for v in grid[r])]
    col_seps = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 0 for r in range(h))]
    row_bounds = [-1] + row_seps + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + col_seps + [w]
    # The most frequent nonzero color is the panel background.
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != 0)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = []
    for ri in range(len(row_bounds) - 1):
        r0, r1 = row_bounds[ri] + 1, row_bounds[ri + 1]
        if r0 == r1:
            continue
        row = []
        for ci in range(len(col_bounds) - 1):
            c0, c1 = col_bounds[ci] + 1, col_bounds[ci + 1]
            if c0 == c1:
                continue
            n = sum(grid[r][c] not in (0, background)
                    for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1))
            row.append(1 if n == 2 else background)
        out.append(row)
    return out
'''
